core_rules: Recovery, publication intent, disclosure state, provider visibility, and heavy-byte retention are independent decisions.
Quota pressure never authorizes publication, deletion, paid capacity, or scientific changes.
Mixed heavy repositories use DECOMPOSE_REQUIRED and must be classified at payload level before visibility or deletion changes.

publication_intent.PUBLIC_RELEASE: Approved reader/reproducer-facing release asset; normally disclosure_state=PUBLIC.
publication_intent.TEMPORARILY_PRIVATE: Not public now because research/method/release scope is not ready; future bounded release is plausible.
publication_intent.INTERNAL_PRIVATE: Internal research, recovery, diagnostic, raw-evidence, or control-plane material; no routine public-release intent.
publication_intent.NEVER_PUBLIC: Credentials, non-redistributable data, third-party confidential material, or other permanently excluded payload.

retention_intent.KEEP_EXACT: Historical bytes/serialization/checkpoint identity itself is evidence and must remain exact.
retention_intent.KEEP_RECONSTRUCTIBLE: Pinned inputs and reconstruction path are sufficient; exact historical heavy bytes are not required.
retention_intent.POINTER_ONLY: Approved canonical bytes exist elsewhere; retain immutable pointer/hash/join only.
retention_intent.RETIREMENT_CANDIDATE: Compatibility/duplicate/superseded copy that may be deleted only after reference, liveness, recovery, retention, and owner gates.
retention_intent.DECOMPOSE_REQUIRED: Container mixes multiple roles; classify payloads individually before publication or deletion. After decomposition the repo may remain DECOMPOSE_REQUIRED, but current governance must retain a COMPLETE payload-level ledger/evidence pointer.
